semantics.located: diagnostic co-location with a simple fix-class name; not verified root-cause detection
semantics.repair: mechanical warning-key response; not semantic correctness
semantics.usable: accepted run status AND parseable raw output; does not assert complete compilation or analysis
semantics.tp_any_tp_dom: legacy column names retained only for shape compatibility
semantics.warning_volume: selected diagnostic counts, not precision; differing analysis coverage remains

filter.message: case-sensitive substring ThreadLocal in full raw diagnostic message
filter.source: any main diagnostic source span, start..min(end,start+4); point locations inspect one line
filter.field: same-file ThreadLocal declaration regex restricted lexically to direct class body; not name binding
filter.secondary_paths: Infer traces, CodeQL related locations/code flows and Sonar flows excluded
filter.spotbugs_location: direct BugInstance SourceLine primary or first; then primary Method/Field SourceLine; then primary Class
filter.dedicated: rule whitelist intersection with exactly the same relevance filter

out_of_scope.PMD: no identified dedicated rule in configured stock inventory
out_of_scope.Infer: no identified dedicated rule in configured stock inventory
out_of_scope.CodeQL: no identified dedicated rule in configured stock inventory

definitions.location: Recorded REPORT co-locates with a fix class; not manually confirmed root-cause detection
definitions.operational_scope: Artifact availability and warning volume use all 159 prepared pairs (264 unique pre/post releases), including 13 records excluded from location and repair scoring
definitions.warning_volume: Distinct usable pre releases in the full prepared inventory, including controls and unscored records; buggy_versions_ok is a legacy field name
definitions.some: At least one old matched key is absent after repair
definitions.all: No old matched key remains; new post keys can still exist
definitions.silent: No REPORT is matched to any fix class after repair
definitions.units: Approximation: repository and space-joined fix-class names, not independently adjudicated fix families

limitations: Fix-class matching uses simple names and broad declaration/method/site co-location
Pair VALID is a bytecode-change check, not a semantic regression-test oracle
Native diagnostics share a relevance predicate, but rule configuration and semantic input coverage differ
Precision sample verdicts are not filled; no manual precision estimates are generated
Some evaluation rows represent related reports or backports; no independence-based tests are generated
